name: Money Heist
description: To carry out the biggest heist in history, a mysterious man called The Professor recruits a band of eight robbers who have a single characteristic: none of them has anything to lose. Five months of seclusion - memorizing every step, every detail, every probability - culminate in eleven days locked up in the National Coinage and Stamp Factory of Spain, surrounded by police forces and with dozens of hostages in their power, to find out whether their suicide wager will lead to everything or nothing.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: The Professor recruits a young female robber and seven other criminals for a grand heist, targeting the Royal Mint of Spain.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Hostage negotiator Raquel makes initial contact with the Professor. One of the hostages is a crucial part of the thieves' plans.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Police grab an image of the face of one of the robbers. Raquel is suspicious of the gentleman she meets at a bar.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Raquel suffers a personal crisis with her ex. The hostages are frightened by the gunshots they overheard. The thieves argue among themselves.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: The thieves let a medical team enter the Mint, and an undercover policeman sneaks in with them. Can the Professor stay one step ahead of Raquel?

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Mónica's condition worsens. The Professor enjoys the spoils of his latest trick. Río is disturbed by news he sees on the television.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: A break in the investigation and a mistake by one of the thieves puts the Professor at serious risk of being discovered.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Tokyo catches Alison chatting with Río and confronts her. The police suspect a spy is in their midst.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: The Professor races to stop a witness from identifying him. Berlín seeks revenge once his own name is revealed and slandered in the press.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Raquel enters the Mint to ascertain that all of the hostages are still alive and well. Nairobi gives Alison advice.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Ángel and Raquel question each other's loyalties. Mónica makes a move on Denver. Río is faced with a difficult decision.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Arturo continues to formulate an escape plan for a group of hostages. The Professor reveals who gave him the idea for the heist.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: The Professor meets Raquel's mother under stressful circumstances. At the Mint, the thieves offer the hostages a decision: money or freedom?

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: As forensic experts comb the Toledo country house for DNA, the Professor loses control. Inside the Mint, the robbers' nerves reach a breaking point.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: The police interrogate the first robber to be captured. Furious over Berlín's recent actions, Río takes a stand against him.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Hoping to learn the Professor's identity, Raquel appeals to her captive's emotions. A punishment for "high treason" sparks a revolt among the robbers.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Recognizing their plan isn't working out, the robbers instead aim to win over the public via the press. Raquel plots a trap to capture the Professor.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Arturo tries to set another escape plan in motion. During a conversation with Salva, Raquel spots a tiny detail that gets her mind racing.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: After confessing a long-held secret, Moscow loses his son's trust. A contingency plan to free Tokyo hits a snag, forcing her to improvise.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: With one of their own critically injured, the robbers race against time to save his life. During a moment alone, Ariadna makes a confession to Mónica.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: After being removed from the case due to her relationship with the Professor, Raquel sets out to conduct her own search for the mastermind.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: As the police enter the Mint, Berlín leads the robbers in a final showdown. Will they escape with the 984 million euros—and with their lives intact?

videos.title: We're Back
videos.overview: When Rio is captured, a distraught Tokyo turns to the Professor for help. Armed with a bold new plan, they reunite the team in order to rescue him.

videos.title: Aikido
videos.overview: The Professor recruits Martin to put his brother's plan into action and target the Bank of Spain. First step? Create total chaos.

videos.title: 48 Meters Underground
videos.overview: Tokyo and Nairobi's efforts go drastically awry. The Professor recalls Berlin detailing how they'd steal the gold from the water-logged vault.

videos.title: It's Dolphin Time
videos.overview: Tamayo's breaches of protocol surprise the Professor. Bogota calms Denver's anxieties. With time running out, Palermo initiates the "Flipper" plan.

videos.title: Boom, Boom, Ciao
videos.overview: The Professor shocks officials with his latest stunt, but in response, a new inspector rattles Raquel. Palermo and Nairobi get into a heated argument.

videos.title: Everything Seemed Insignificant
videos.overview: Just as Inspector Sierra orchestrates a plan to sneak a team into the Bank of Spain, the Professor and Raquel lose communication with Palermo.

videos.title: A Quick Vacation
videos.overview: Tokyo's happiness turns bittersweet. Angel closes in on a quarreling Raquel and the Professor. Authorities offer a multimillion-dollar reward for tips.

videos.title: Astray
videos.overview: Tokyo attempts to drown her sorrows. Sierra uses personal tactics to target a vulnerable Nairobi, while Suarez continues to hunt down Raquel.

videos.title: Game Over
videos.overview: Anger and grief heighten tensions between the group. The Professor, while in mourning, attempts to make a daring and dangerous escape.

videos.title: Berlin's Wedding
videos.overview: Palermo shocks the group with his actions. Sierra pressures her subject to take a deal. The Professor remembers his brother's wedding.

videos.title: Anatomy Lesson
videos.overview: The Professor's mole attempts to pass along his message to the person inside the tent. Denver's jealousy toward Mónica and Rio's friendship heightens.

videos.title: Pasodoble
videos.overview: In the past, Berlin predicts that Gandía will cause problems for the operation. Sierra's interrogation of Lisboa leads to a personal revelation.

videos.title: 5 Minutes Earlier
videos.overview: Denver turns to an undercover source for help. Nairobi attempts to motivate her team as the danger around them intensifies.

videos.title: TKO
videos.overview: With Nairobi held hostage, Gandía negotiates with the crew. The Professor desperately seeks a new plan to save his team.

videos.title: Strike the Tent
videos.overview: The group reels following the attack on one of their own. The Professor puts his adjusted plan in motion with the help of new recruits and Palermo.

videos.title: The Paris Plan
videos.overview: The Professor, Benjamin and the others attempt to free Lisboa. Tokyo's anger threatens her faith in the plan. Sierra takes matters into her own hands.

videos.title: The End of the Road
videos.overview: The Professor faces off with Sierra as Tamayo raises the stakes of the negotiations by calling the army. In the past, Berlin meets with a family member.

videos.title: Do You Believe in Reincarnation?
videos.overview: Arturo seizes an opportunity to fight back while escalating a personal vengeance. Lisbon makes a crucial discovery.

videos.title: The Spectacle of Life
videos.overview: A betrayaland an emergency both catch Sierra by surprise. Palermo rallies the troops as the army closes in on the gang.

videos.title: Your Place in Heaven
videos.overview: With Helsinki's life in danger, the thieves mount a covert counter attack. Years earlier, Berlin and his son conduct their first heist together.

videos.title: Live Many Lives
videos.overview: While surrounded by gunfire and trapped in the kitchen, Tokyo reminisces about her first love and her initial encounter with the Professor.

videos.title: Escape Valve
videos.overview: Sierra takes advantage of the Professor's grief and gains the upper hand. Meanwhile, the team deals with the emotional fallout of their dead friend.

videos.title: Wishful Thinking
videos.overview: Tamayo mounts a manhunt in his neighborhood as his foes hide. In the past, Berlin and Palermo explain how they plan on getting the gold out of the bank.

videos.title: The Elegance Theory
videos.overview: Tamayo hunts for the gold as the team races against the clock. Mónica worries she's having a psychotic break. Years earlier, Berlin is deceived.

videos.title: Pillow Talk
videos.overview: The Professor is left reeling after his tactics are used against him, and when it seems like all hope is lost, he makes a bold decision.

videos.title: A Family Tradition
videos.overview: With multiple lives on the line and Spain's economy at stake, the Professor and Tamayo engage in one final showdown.
